最初のハントを一緒に進める: Work through your first hunt together
画面の見方と、検索から回答までの操作: Learn the interface and the steps from searching to answering
部署の端末から sync-demo.example への通信が記録されています。: Traffic from departmental endpoints to sync-demo.example has been recorded. Find the endpoint involved and retain one record as evidence. This exercise does not ask you to decide whether the traffic is dangerous.
操作専用の小さな架空環境です。左が調査依頼、中央が調査道具、右が証拠と回答を置く: This small fictional environment is for practicing the interface. The hunt brief is on the left, investigation tools are in the center, and hunt notes for evidence and answers are on the right. On a phone, these appear vertically in that order. Follow the instructions by operating the highlighted controls, not just reading them.
端末・通信先・時刻を記録しています。通信先の名前だけでは目的や安全性は判断できま: Records include the endpoint, destination, and time. A destination's name alone does not establish its purpose or safety.
画面の3つの場所を知る: Get to know the three areas of the screen
左の「調査依頼」を読んでください。中央で調べ、右の「ハントノート」に根拠と回答を: Read the Hunt brief on the left. Investigate in the center, and keep evidence and answers in Hunt notes on the right. This time, determine which endpoint was involved. Select Next when you have finished reading.
中央の検索欄に destination:sync-demo.example と入: Enter destination:sync-demo.example in the central search field and select Search. Specifying the destination narrows the candidates. You can continue when two results remain.
検索結果のどちらかで「記録の詳細」を押してください。時刻・端末・通信先が1行の記: Select Record details on either search result. Each record contains the time, endpoint, and destination. Close the dialog after checking them.
根拠をハントノートに残す: Keep evidence in your hunt notes
検索結果のどちらか1件の「＋ 証拠に追加」を押してください。右側のハントノートへ: Select + Add evidence on either search result. The record is added to Hunt notes on the right. The original log is not removed.
ハントノートにある証拠の役割を「支持 — 事実・仮説の根拠」に変えてください。こ: Change the evidence role in Hunt notes to Support — Evidence for the fact or hypothesis. This means you are using it to identify the endpoint that made this connection.
右の「回答・まとめ」を押します。「証拠」は根拠を置く場所、「回答・まとめ」は調査: Select Answers & summary on the right. Evidence holds your supporting records; Answers & summary holds what you learned from the investigation.
「調査結果として挙げる端末」で、通信記録に書かれた端末だけを選んでください。調査: Under Endpoints identified by the investigation, select only the endpoint named in the traffic record. Investigation notes are optional. You may reopen the evidence details to check.
ハントノートの「証拠と回答を確認する」を押します。未達成の項目があれば内容を修正: Select Check evidence and answers in Hunt notes. If any criteria are unmet, revise your work and check again. Wrong answers and retries do not reduce your score.
解説で考え方を振り返る: Review the reasoning in the explanation
採点結果の「解説で振り返る」を押してください。解説を見る操作は、正解を自動入力す: Select Review the explanation in the assessment results. Opening the explanation does not fill in the correct answers. Compare it with your evidence before closing it.
検索→詳細を読む→証拠と役割を残す→回答→確認、が基本の流れです。上の「保存」は: The basic flow is search → read details → retain evidence and its role → answer → check. Save at the top exports progress JSON; Save report exports this investigation's record. Continue with Foundations 01 to practice aggregation and comparison.
中央で通信先を絞ると、どの端末の記録があるか見えます。: Narrowing the destination in the central view shows which endpoints have matching records.
記録を1件ハントノートへ追加し、事実の根拠として役割を指定します。: Add one record to Hunt notes and assign a role that supports the observed fact.
検索結果の端末名と、回答欄の選択が一致しているか確認しましょう。: Check that the endpoint selected in your answer matches the endpoint in the search results.
通信した端末を示す記録: A record identifying the endpoint that communicated
通信記録にある端末を、同じ記録を根拠にして回答できました。: You identified the endpoint in the traffic record and used that same record as evidence.
通信先を絞ると、DEMO-WS-02の記録が2件残ります。: Filtering by destination leaves two records for DEMO-WS-02.
どちらか1件を「支持」として残せば、端末を回答する根拠になります。: Keeping either record as Support provides evidence for your endpoint answer.
ここで確認できたのは通信の存在です。実際のハントでは、実行元や正当な業務も調べて: This establishes that communication occurred. In a real hunt, investigate the originating process and legitimate business activity before reaching a conclusion.
入門01へ進み、似た名前の宛先を区別して調べましょう。: Continue to Foundations 01 to distinguish destinations with similar names.

引継メモに「helpdeskを含む通信を確認」とあります。まず候補を探し、正式な: A handoff note says to check traffic containing helpdesk. First find candidates, then identify the endpoint whose destination value matches the actual investigation target, helpdesk-updates.example.
期間は9月14日〜16日UTCです。検索語は通信先以外の項目や、似た名前にも含ま: The period is September 14–16 UTC. The search term may appear in other fields or similar names. Practice reading the destination value instead of accepting every matching row as an answer. This task does not assess the destination's safety. Dates and times in the text, reference material, and model answers are UTC. References to early morning or nighttime also mean UTC times, not local working hours.
端末からの通信先、時刻、プロセスなどを記録した合成ログです。通信内容の全文はあり: Synthetic logs recording endpoint destinations, times, and processes. They do not contain the full communication content.
現在期間でhelpdeskを検索します。これは全体から語句を探す検索なので、通信: Search for helpdesk in the current period. This searches across fields, so it also matches the word in URL paths, not only destinations.
値を確かめて絞る: Inspect the values and narrow the results
各行の通信先を読み、正式な名前helpdesk-updates.exampleと: Read each destination and compare it with the exact name helpdesk-updates.example. destination:helpdesk-updates.example restricts the search to the destination field but still uses partial matching. Distinguish candidates that have another name appended.
一致した行を根拠にする: Use a matching record as evidence
通信先の値が正式な名前と一致する行を1件、役割「支持」で追加します。ここで支持す: Add one record whose destination value matches the exact name, with the Support role. The supported fact here is that a record exists for the specified destination.
報告欄で調査対象の端末を選び、答え合わせします。この課題では仮説・結論・総合報告: Select the investigation target endpoint in the report area, then check your answer. Hypotheses, verdicts, and overall reports are not graded in this task.
ヒットした理由が通信先なのか、パスに含まれた文字なのかを確認します。: Check whether a result matched because of the destination or because the text appeared in a path.
destination:helpdesk-updates.exampleでは4件: destination:helpdesk-updates.example produces four candidates. The one ending in .cdn.example is a different destination.
候補の通信先を先頭から末尾まで読み、依頼の値と一致する行を選びます。その行の端末: Read each candidate's destination from beginning to end and select a record matching the requested value. Carry its endpoint and the fact it supports into your answer.
指定された通信先の記録: A record for the specified destination
検索候補と通信先の値を比較し、対象から除いた記録。: A record excluded after comparing the candidate's destination value with the requested destination.
WS-14から指定された通信先への通信が3件記録されています。: Three connections from WS-14 to the specified destination were recorded.
helpdeskだけの検索では、helpdesk.exampleへの要求パスに含: Searching for helpdesk alone also matches text in a request path to helpdesk.example. The destination itself does not necessarily match.
destination:で検索対象の項目を限定しても部分一致です。helpdes: Restricting the field with destination: still uses partial matching. The longer value helpdesk-updates.example.cdn.example differs from the exact requested name.
WS-14の3件は通信先の値が一致しています。これだけで侵害、送信内容、安全性を: The three WS-14 records have matching destination values. This alone does not establish compromise, transmitted content, or safety.
次は、何を確かめたいのかを仮説にし、必要なログを選びます。: Next, turn what you want to find out into a hypothesis and choose the necessary logs.
対象期間2026-09-14〜2026-09-16 UTCの合成通信ログで、WS: The synthetic traffic logs for 2026-09-14 through 2026-09-16 UTC contain three connections from WS-14 to helpdesk-updates.example. These records alone were not used to judge whether the communication was legitimate.

svc-reportの夜間利用を点検します。予定された報告処理との関係を調べるた: Review nighttime use of svc-report. Choose a hypothesis about its relationship to scheduled reporting and the two data sources needed to compare them.
夜間の認証には定期処理という説明も考えられます。認証ログだけでは「予定された作業: Scheduled processing is one possible explanation for nighttime authentication. Authentication logs alone cannot show whether the activity was scheduled. Focus on connecting the investigation question with the necessary data before deciding. Dates and times in the text, reference material, and model answers are UTC. References to early morning or nighttime mean UTC times, not local working hours.
夜間認証の発生は、報告ファイルを再生成する処理に伴うものか: Does the nighttime authentication accompany regeneration of report files?
夜間認証の端末と時刻は、予定された報告処理に一致しているか: Do the endpoints and times of nighttime authentication match the scheduled reporting process?
夜間認証の発生は、担当者が手動で行う対話型の作業によるものか: Does the nighttime authentication result from interactive work performed manually by an operator?
利用者、端末、サインインの時刻と結果を記録した合成ログです。本人が操作したことま: Synthetic logs recording the user, endpoint, sign-in time, and result. They do not prove that the account owner personally performed the action.
作業予定や対象端末などの架空の管理記録です。実行ログと照合して利用します。: Fictional administrative records such as scheduled work and target endpoints. Compare them with execution logs.
仮説の候補から、svc-reportの夜間利用と予定された処理との関係を確かめる: Choose the hypothesis that checks the relationship between nighttime svc-report use and scheduled processing.
実際に誰が、どの端末で、いつ認証したかは認証ログで確認します。予定された端末や時: Use authentication logs to check which account authenticated, on which endpoint, and when. Use business records to check the scheduled endpoints and times.
調査の起点を保存する: Save the starting point of the investigation
現在期間のsvc-reportの認証を一つ根拠に追加し、役割は「背景」にします。: Add one current-period authentication record for svc-report as Context. It establishes the account usage you will investigate, not a conclusion about legitimacy.
報告欄のデータ種別で認証と業務を選びます。この課題は仮説・必要なデータ・起点の根: Select 認証 (authentication) and 業務 (business) as the data sources in the report area. This task checks the hypothesis, required data, and starting-point evidence.
いずれも夜間認証に関係する問いですが、今回は予定の端末・時刻との照合が目的です。: All of these questions concern nighttime authentication, but this investigation specifically compares it with scheduled endpoints and times.
認証の事実には認証ログ、予定との照合には業務の記録が必要です。ファイル再生成を調: Authentication logs establish that authentication occurred; business records let you compare it with the schedule. Investigating file regeneration would require other records.
問いの「予定との一致」を確かめるため、観測した事実と予定をそれぞれ示す資料を探し: To test whether the activity matches the schedule, find records of the observed activity and of the plan. The first authentication is a starting point for investigation, not evidence of a verdict.
対象週の端末・アカウント・時刻を照合できる予定票。: A schedule that allows comparison of endpoints, accounts, and times during the target week.
夜間の定期処理が比較期間にも記録されていることを示す背景。: Context showing that scheduled nighttime processing also occurred during the baseline period.
認証の事実と業務予定を照合できる仮説・データを選びます。: Choose a hypothesis and data that let you compare observed authentication with the business schedule.
svc-reportのJOB-01での00:10 UTCの認証は、夜間利用を調べ: The svc-report authentication on JOB-01 at 00:10 UTC is a starting point for reviewing nighttime use.
業務記録には対象端末・アカウント・予定時刻があります。予定だけで実行を証明したり: Business records specify the endpoint, account, and scheduled time. A schedule alone does not prove execution, and authentication alone does not establish that the work was approved.
ファイル再生成や担当者の手動処理も調査の問いにはなりますが、今回の依頼は定期予定: File regeneration and manual work by an operator could also be investigated, but this request concerns comparison with the recurring schedule. The question determines which data you need.
必要なデータが決まったら、件数を集計して調べる対象を絞ります。: Once you have chosen the necessary data, aggregate counts to narrow down what to investigate.
svc-reportの夜間認証が予定された報告処理と一致するかを調べる。認証ログ: Investigate whether nighttime svc-report authentication matches the scheduled reporting process. Check endpoints and times in authentication logs against business schedules. Retained the JOB-01 authentication at 00:10 UTC as the starting point.
多い理由を確認し、次の候補を選ぶ: Explain high counts, then choose the next candidate
現在期間の通信を端末別に集計してください。上位の記録を読み、既知の更新処理で件数: Aggregate current-period traffic by endpoint. Read the highest-count records and separate activity explained by a known update process. Then choose the endpoint whose originating process needs a closer look.
Count all 24 records, one per row. The known update process is client-updater.exe contacting client-updates.example. Certificate renewal from certs.example is also part of it. This business note does not describe other programs. Dates and times in the text, reference material, and model answers are UTC. Early morning and nighttime refer to UTC, not local working hours.
期間、取得項目、保存対象を示す架空の収集台帳です。イベント本文とは別に確認します: A fictional collection inventory describing the period, collected fields, and retained data. Check it separately from event content.
ログ検索の条件を解除し、種類を通信にして現在期間の全通信を表示します。集計タブで: Clear the log-search filters, choose 通信 (traffic), and display all current-period traffic. In Aggregation, group by Endpoint and run the aggregation to check the highest counts.
最多の理由を読む: Read why the count is highest
最多の端末をクリックして記録へ進みます。status=503はサーバーが一時的に: Select the highest-count endpoint to inspect its records. status=503 means the server was temporarily unable to handle the request; attempt is the attempt number. Retain a record with the same job_id that eventually returned 200 after retries as Counter-evidence. It challenges the idea of choosing an investigation target from counts alone.
条件を解除してもう一度集計し、次に件数の多い端末を調べます。実行プロセスと通信先: Clear the filters, aggregate again, and inspect the endpoint with the next-highest count. Compare its process and destination with the known update process, and retain a record needing further investigation as Support.
追加確認する端末を選ぶ: Select the endpoint for further investigation
報告欄では、更新再試行で説明できた最多端末ではなく、次に実行元を詳しく確認する端: In the report, choose the endpoint whose originating process needs investigation, not the highest-count endpoint explained by update retries. You are not yet determining whether an attack occurred.
件数は9・6・3・3・3です。多さと、処理が説明できるかを別々に考えます。: The counts are 9, 6, 3, 3, and 3. Consider the count separately from whether the process can be explained.
上位の各端末を開き、同じジョブの再試行で件数を説明できるか確認します。次の候補は: Open each leading endpoint and check whether retries of the same job explain its count. For the next candidate, compare the process and destination with the known activity.
最多の理由を説明する一連の応答と、次の候補の実行元を比べます。件数だけの判断を見: Compare the response sequence explaining the highest count with the next candidate's originating process. Select evidence that challenges a count-only judgment and evidence supporting further investigation.
最多の件数を説明する更新再試行: Update retries explaining the highest count
次に実行元を確認する通信: Traffic whose originating process needs investigation next
通信の件数・結果・実行元と、保存しない本文の範囲。: The traffic counts, results, and originating process, plus the boundary of unretained content.
同じ更新ジョブのHTTP503と再試行の経過を示す背景。: Context showing HTTP 503 responses and retries for the same update job.
既知の更新処理や証明書更新との比較材料。: Comparison with known updates and certificate renewal.
最多のWS-22は更新の再試行で件数を説明できます。次候補のWS-23は別の実行: Update retries explain the highest count on WS-22. The next candidate, WS-23, uses a different originating process and needs further investigation.
WS-22は9件、WS-23は6件、残り3端末は各3件です。WS-22では各日の: WS-22 has nine records, WS-23 has six, and the other three endpoints have three each. On WS-22, each day's UPDATE job received HTTP 503 twice, then 200 on its third attempt.
WS-22の多さは既知の更新処理の再試行によるものです。この説明があることと、端: Retries by the known update process explain WS-22's high count. Having that explanation does not establish that the entire endpoint is safe.
WS-23のsession-helper.exeからsession-sync.e: Traffic from session-helper.exe to session-sync.example on WS-23 differs from the supplied known-update conditions. This warrants checking the program's purpose and distribution, but does not prove malicious intent.
1件だけ現れるcerts.exampleへの通信も既知の証明書更新です。少ないこ: The single connection to certs.example is also a known certificate renewal. Low frequency or rarity alone does not establish danger either.
基準期間のログは収録していないため、普段より増えたという判断はできません。: No baseline-period logs are included, so you cannot conclude that activity increased above normal.
次は同じ長さの基準期間を用意し、件数の変化を比べます。: Next, compare changes in counts using a baseline period of the same length.
現在期間の通信24件を集計した。WS-22が9件で最多だが、既知の更新ジョブの5: Aggregated 24 current-period traffic records. WS-22 has the highest count, nine, explained by retries after 503 responses from a known update job. WS-23 follows with six and uses session-helper.exe, separate from the known updater, so its originating process needs investigation. Maliciousness and differences from normal remain undetermined.
同じ長さの期間で変化を確かめる: Check changes across periods of equal length
基準期間と現在期間の資料取得ログを端末別に比較し、記録件数が増えた端末を探してく: Compare document-retrieval logs by endpoint between the baseline and current periods. Find the endpoint whose record count increased, and retain one record from each period as evidence.
両期間は月曜〜水曜の3日間です。教材では同じ範囲を収録した合成サンプルとして比較: Both periods cover three days, Monday through Wednesday. The synthetic samples are treated as having equivalent coverage. In a real investigation, also check holidays, workload, and differences in collection. Dates and times in the text, reference material, and model answers are UTC. Early morning and nighttime refer to UTC, not local working hours.
ファイルの取得などを記録した合成ログです。取得された内容が安全かどうかは、この記: Synthetic logs of actions such as file retrieval. These records alone do not establish whether the retrieved content is safe.
基準は9月7日〜9日、現在は9月14日〜16日です。両方とも3日間で、資料取得の: The baseline is September 7–9 and the current period is September 14–16. Both cover three days; count document-retrieval records.
比較項目を端末、データ種別をファイルにして比較を実行します。現在の件数だけでなく: Compare by Endpoint using ファイル (file) as the data source. Read the baseline count and difference as well as the current count.
増えた端末の基準期間の行を「背景」、現在期間の行を「支持」で保存します。ログ表示: For the endpoint whose count increased, retain a baseline record as Context and a current-period record as Support. Change the log period to inspect each.
変化と判断を分ける: Separate the change from the verdict
報告欄で増えた端末を選びます。作業量の増加か不正利用かの結論は、この課題では求め: Select the endpoint whose count increased in the report area. This task does not ask you to decide whether the increase reflects workload or misuse.
差が0でない端末を探します。今回、減った端末はありません。: Find an endpoint with a nonzero difference. None of the endpoints decreased in this sample.
比較表の差分が大きい候補へ進み、取得対象と記録の種類が両期間で同じかを確認します: Inspect the candidate with the largest difference in the comparison table, and check that retrieval targets and record types are comparable across both periods.
差が大きい候補について、同じ種類の取得を両期間から一つずつ選びます。前週を比較の: For that candidate, select one retrieval of the same type from each period. Use the previous week as comparison context and the current change as the investigation's starting point.

比較した他端末の取得記録。母集団と期間の対応を示す材料。: Retrieval records from other endpoints used for comparison, showing the population and period alignment.
WS-32の資料取得は3件から9件に増え、差は6件です。: Document retrieval on WS-32 increased from three to nine records, a difference of six.
WS-31・WS-33・WS-34は各期間3件です。WS-32だけが増加していま: WS-31, WS-33, and WS-34 have three records in each period. Only WS-32 increased.
3倍という値は、この教材の3件と9件の比です。これだけで異常や大量持ち出しと判断: The threefold increase is the ratio of nine to three records in this sample. It alone does not establish an anomaly or bulk exfiltration.
保存した個別ログは両期間の記録を示します。総件数は比較結果で確かめる必要がありま: Individual retained logs show records from both periods. Use the comparison results to establish the total counts.
変化が見つかった対象を軸に、別の種類のログへ調査を広げます。: Use the endpoint showing a change as the pivot for investigating other types of logs.
